verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Supermemory only in the MCP server role: its own MCP gives assistants a memory layer, and a docs MCP helps coding agents. Nothing shows Supermemory acting as an MCP client that can register external MCP servers and call their tools. Its connectors (Drive, Notion, etc.) are fixed data-sync integrations, not MCP tool consumption, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
